result: The definition of a "reliable account" is based on a PCI score greater than 0.8 and either no detection time recorded or the last detection time being more than 180 days ago. The term "haven't been active recently" refers to accounts where the last activity proxy time is more than 90 days ago. We need to add a new text column named `review_priority` to the `account` table to flag these accounts.

-- Test query to find reliable accounts not active recently
WITH account_security AS (
    SELECT 
        a.accindex,
        MAX(sd.detecttime) as max_detecttime,
        MAX(sd.lastupd) as max_lastupd
    FROM account a
    JOIN profile p ON a.accindex = p.profaccref
    JOIN sessionbehavior sb ON p.profkey = sb.sessprofref
    JOIN networkmetrics nm ON sb.sessref = nm.netsessref
    JOIN technicalinfo ti ON nm.netkey = ti.technetref
    JOIN securitydetection sd ON ti.techkey = sd.sectechref
    GROUP BY a.accindex
),
account_moderation AS (
    SELECT 
        a.accindex,
        ma.reputscore
    FROM account a
    JOIN profile p ON a.accindex = p.profaccref
    JOIN sessionbehavior sb ON p.profkey = sb.sessprofref
    JOIN contentbehavior cb ON sb.sessref = cb.cntsessref
    JOIN moderationaction ma ON cb.cntref = ma.macntref
)
SELECT 
    a.accindex,
    am.reputscore,
    as_.max_detecttime,
    as_.max_lastupd,
    CASE WHEN CURRENT_DATE - as_.max_detecttime > 180 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END as old_detection,
    CASE WHEN CURRENT_DATE - as_.max_lastupd > 90 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END as old_activity
FROM account a
JOIN account_security as_ ON a.accindex = as_.accindex
JOIN account_moderation am ON a.accindex = am.accindex
WHERE am.reputscore > 0.8
  AND (as_.max_detecttime IS NULL OR CURRENT_DATE - as_.max_detecttime > 180)
  AND CURRENT_DATE - as_.max_lastupd > 90
LIMIT 10;
